messages:
Jon: Quick sync — we need to finalize the Q3 perf bets for the runtime sprint. Primary goals: kernels, quantization, and KV-cache heuristics. Can we lock scope by EOD tomorrow?

Maya: +1. My baseline proposal is two parallel workstreams: (1) kernel improvements (fused-attn + selective matmul) and (2) quantization pipeline (PTQ + eval). KV cache work is cross-cutting and smaller.

Devon: FYI customer ask from Acme: 512-token chat p95 regressions under bursty traffic. They see throughput drop when KV-miss rate spikes. Repro link: https://redwood.internal/repro/ACME-472

Jon: We should define concrete acceptance criteria. Draft: 1.3x throughput on 512-token chat; p95 latency down ~20% vs current baseline under our standard batch mix. Thoughts?

Maya: Acceptance criteria draft so far:
- p95 latency <= 220ms on g4dn for chat-512 (default load)
- throughput >= 1.3x baseline for gen workloads with identical batching
- CI perf gate + no quality regressions on golden prompts

Liam: Add SLO guardrails: quality delta <= 2% (measured by our eval harness). If quality regresses >2% we block rollout. Also need token-level latency dashboards.

Kate: Tradeoffs need to be explicit. If INT8 quant reduces cost but regresses quality slightly, we need an automatic rollback and a canary plan (5% traffic for 48h). Document the rollback playbook.

Devon: Scheduling notes: kernel work is a 3-week spike+implementation; quant PTQ + calibration 4 weeks; KV heuristics spike 1 week. We'll likely overlap. Need help from eng-infra for kernel deps.

Jon: Resource ask: reserve 2 GPUs for perf runs for the next 4 weeks. @infra-bot can you provision?

infra-bot: Reserved 2 p4d instances for eng-runtime/perf-sprint from 2026-03-23 to 2026-04-20 :white_check_mark:

Maya: Proposed MVP scope for the sprint:
- Kernel: integrate fused-attn v2, add selective matmul kernel, gate both behind feature flags
- Quant: add INT8 PTQ flow + golden-prompts evaluation suite
- KV: implement threshold-based eviction and adaptive prefetch heuristics

Jon: If we timebox, cut plan: drop matmul integration and keep fused-attn only.

Alex: Benchmark command I'm using locally: 
```
python rbench.py --model redwood-v1 --seq 512 --batch 8 --runs 50
```
Posting results to #perf-results after tonight's run.

Maya: Risk note: kernels rely on CUDA 12.2 upstream changes. Platform rollout could block. Mitigation: build fallback kernel and ship in container so we can flip without infra upgrade.

Kate: Launch criteria before enabling feature flag to prod:
- CI perf gate green
- Eval delta <= 1% on our quality suite (golden prompts + user traces)
- Canary: 5% traffic for 48h with monitoring and rollback plan
- Observability: token-level latency breakdown + tracing enabled

Devon: Owners (proposed):
- Maya -> kernels implementation + feature flag
- Alex -> benchmarking, dashboards, and perf runs
- Devon -> KV heuristics + customer repros
- Kate -> rollout plan + external comms
- Liam -> SLOs + eval harness integration

Jon: Agreed. Action items: owners to update the PRD with scoped list and timelines by 1950200000 (rooted timestamp). Final scope lock meeting tomorrow 10am PST.

Sam: Noted — I'll prep customer comms template in case we hit canary and need to notify customers.

Maya: I'll also open a spike PR for the fused-attn integration today and tag infra for kernel deps.

Alex: Will run the nightly batch of benchmarks and share aggregated results in #perf-results.

Liam: I'll wire up the token-level latency panels and add alerts for p95 > 250ms during canary.

Jon: Thanks everyone. This gives us a clear, pragmatic sprint. :rocket:

(reacts: :thumbsup: from Kate, :eyes: from Devon)
